how.headline: How it works
how.description: Naura Meets is a service of regular introductions to interesting people. Fill out a short profile about yourself, once a week get a person's card and arrange a meeting. Afterwards — you leave a review that improves the quality of the next matches

paragraphs: Our own team is the first proof that this works.

It started when Ilya built a simple bot to introduce GetMentor.dev mentors to one another. That is how he met Misha, who suggested growing the bot into a real matching service. Vova joined us later — we met the very same way.

Thousands of kilometres lie between us, and it does not stop us being friends and building Naura Meets together — so that anyone can find useful connections, friends and simply good company just as easily. They are in short supply these days.
note.signature: Ilya, Mikhail, Vladimir, founders of Naura Meets

items.question: What if the match doesn't suit me?
items.answer: On Wednesday you can ask for a replacement — we'll find a new person for this week. And your rating after the meeting makes the next match more precise.

items.question: Can I choose who to meet with?
items.answer: You can't pick a specific person, but matching adapts to you: goals and interests from your profile set the direction, and your ratings refine it with every round.

items.question: How often do I need to participate?
items.answer: Every week you receive an invitation — decide for yourself. Skip a round — nothing happens, return when convenient.

items.question: Where do meetings take place?
items.answer: Online or in person — you decide with your match, and you can arrange it right in Telegram.

items.question: How long does launch take?
items.answer: Setup — 10 minutes. Then everything works automatically.

items.question: Can I limit participants?
items.answer: Yes, configure access by groups, meeting format, round frequency.

items.question: What if participants don't meet?
items.answer: We monitor this: a mid-week check-in, the option to replace a match, ratings after the round. You see the statistics.

items.question: How much does it cost for a community?
items.answer: It depends on the community size and format. Leave a request — we'll share the terms and help you launch.
